exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, primary cesarean section, secondary cesarean section)
outcome: Umbilical cord serum neurofilament light chain (NfL) concentration
finding: Neonates born via vaginal delivery had significantly higher umbilical cord serum NfL concentrations, a biomarker of neuroaxonal damage, compared to those born via cesarean section.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was associated with higher NfL levels compared to non-assisted vaginal delivery, while cesarean section was associated with the lowest NfL levels.
